fee_notes: Royalty Fee is 7% of Gross Sales, paid weekly (each Friday) on prior week's Gross Sales. Marketing Funds contribution is 5% of Gross Sales, paid on the same Payment Day schedule. Software License Fee is currently $249/month; increases to $416/month if franchisee uses POS System Surveillance Software; subject to annual CPI-based increases (CPI-U + 2%, capped at 5% annually) plus franchisor discretion to increase beyond that cap. Non-Recorded Payment fee is the greater of $1,500 or 120% of the last recorded period's Royalty Fees. Management fee of 3% of Gross Sales applies if franchisor appoints a manager to operate the Center. Transfer/training fee is 50% of then-current initial franchise fee (currently $17,500). Resale assistance fee is 10% of purchase price. Franchisor may periodically waive or reduce Royalty Fee and/or Marketing Funds contributions under incentive programs.
